documentation:
The embedded view for the first pane of the MaterialConfig popup. Allows users to select a data source and file to upload data from

Output Data:
-message sent to the dataSourceSelection message handler located on the root of the MaterialConfig view: the FileUpload has events to send a a message upon file uploaded or cleared as well as the binding on the selectedDataSource

Custom Properties:
-custom.data.selectedFile: the data and name of the uploaded file
-custom.data.selectedDataSource: the selected datasource from the dropdown (e.g., csv or erp)
